path_basis: All *_path in outputs and script_path in approvals are forward-slash paths relative to C:/projects/realestate_reco, not episode-relative.
timeline_order: The scenes ARRAY order is authoritative. Never sort scene IDs or chapters. IDs must be unique; R029-R033 can occur after R011. Chapter references must exist but need not be monotonic.
dependency: Existing readonly edge-tts 7.3.1 deps from housing-choice-networth-20261020/narration/free-tts-v1; no installation/authentication/key/billing.

helpers: ../production_v1.py: mapping position, protected_ranges, semantic spans, line breaks
reuse.note: No old paragraph audio is assumed equivalent. A future reuse feature would require exact approved source, spoken text, voice/rate, code/contract and file SHA matches.

network.allowed_only_after: Both parent director script lock (Claude approved, exact SHA/revision) and free text-only Edge execution authorization matching prepared SHA, lock SHA, exact command argv and all scene IDs.
network.external_payload: spoken text only; graphic, visual_notes, source_ids and files are never uploaded
network.max_stream_attempts: One full paragraph stream per scene, bounded by authorization.max_network_attempts = scene count. Each scene must fit one provider text chunk. Edge internal HTTP403 retry disabled.
network.partial_failure: Preserve partial MP3/WAV/WordBoundary and run_receipt.json; no final_timing.json on failure; fresh output and parent instruction needed for a new run.

text_contract.display: Original narration preserved byte-for-character within each source span; cue reassembly comparison ignores whitespace only.
text_contract.spoken: Normalize decimal/comma numerals and DSR/LTV/DTI only by default; ordinary integers and 6억/9억/12억 stay in their original form. Numeric amount is unchanged; decimal fractional digits including zeros are preserved.
text_contract.mapping: Contiguous literal/pronunciation atoms with source_start/source_end and spoken_start/spoken_end. Offsets are Python Unicode codepoints; half-open [start,end). No cue boundary inside a replacement atom. An anchor intersecting a replacement maps to the covering replacement, then covering actual word edges.
text_contract.caption: Semantic sentence/clause grouping, at most 2 display_lines, max 40 Unicode codepoints per line; inherited grammar score and protected number-unit spans. Actual glyph/renderer layout is editor/QA scope.
checks: every provider word used exactly once
numeric/unit protection across cues and lines
text_contract.anchor_policy: Literal unique substring in original narration. Missing/duplicate anchors are errors. Map exact source span to spoken span and use first/last actual WordBoundary covering it, even if an anchor ends within a word. anchor_matches_word_edges discloses whether it exactly matches word edges. No fuzzy match, char-proportion interpolation or fabricated timing.
text_contract.unicode_preflight: Every narration and spoken text requires Hangul count >0; reject consecutive ? or three whitespace-separated ? marks, U+FFFD and surrogates. Numeric phonetic literals are compared with independently escaped Unicode expectations.

timing_contract.all_cues_beats_words: Scene-local seconds from that scene audio24.wav/audio48.wav start, identical across sample rates.
timing_contract.scene_start_s_scene_end_s: Proposed body timeline containing scene WAVs and explicit cut gaps. No brand intro, chapter cards or editor transitions added. Common EDL is locked by director.
timing_contract.internal_pauses: Natural provider pauses preserved. WordBoundary gaps >=0.2s reported as natural_word_gaps; pauses longer than 0.35s do not fail. No sentence TTS calls, no PCM cuts, no pause enforcement.
timing_contract.cut_gap_note: Inserted by editor between scene WAVs, excluded from each duration_s. This is additional silence. Full original PCM is preserved; measured original tail and final delivered tail are reported per scene.
timing_contract.last_speech_basis: max actual provider last word end and measured PCM abs(sample)>=33 end; conservative unlistened bound
timing_contract.total_duration_s: Sum(scene.duration_s) + sum(scene.gap_after_s). Final scene WAV already contains final 3s hold; do not add it twice.

output_layout.audio: One untouched provider MP3 and original decoded 24kHz mono PCM16 WAV per scene. audio24.wav preserves the complete original PCM prefix; append only silence needed for a provider edge beyond PCM (<=0.15s) or final 3s hold. audio48.wav is the 48kHz mono PCM16 conversion.

parent_execution_authorization_required_: allowed_scene_ids=all prepared scene IDs in order
approval_file_location: Both lock and execution authorization must be under this episode/director; this worker never creates or edits actual approval files.
handoff: handoff.json and issue_NARRATION_CONTRACT_V2.json; director confirms shared timeline and forwards contract to Tesla.
